reconciled_discrepancies.finding: P22 integrates into Phase 1 (Perception Foundations), P23 into Phase 2 (Real-Time Cascades), P24 into Phase 3 (Cross-Modal Recovery), and P25 into Phase 7 (Macro Systems Safety prior to P1 Capstone).
P1 serves as the final retrospective capstone synthesis unifying all accepted DOIs in Phase 7.
